seed.name: junctional epidermolysis bullosa with pyloric atresia

partners.mechanism_chain: Integrin Subunit Beta 4 (HGNC:6158) —DISRUPTS→ Integrin beta-4 subunit; Integrin beta-4 subunit —DISRUPTS→ Integrin alpha6beta4 complex (GO:0005913); Integrin alpha6beta4 complex (GO:0005913) —DISRUPTS→ Hemidesmosome assembly (GO:0030055); Hemidesmosome assembly (GO:0030055) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal skin fragility (HP:0001000); Hemidesmosome assembly (GO:0030055) —LEADS_TO→ Pyloric atresia (HP:0011970). Loss-of-function variants in ITGB4 disrupt the formation and function of the integrin alpha6beta4 complex, which is crucial for hemidesmosome assembly. Impaired hemidesmosomes lead to fragile skin, causing blistering (epidermolysis bullosa). Additionally, disruption of hemidesmosomes affects epithelial development and integrity in other tissues, contributing to pyloric atresia.
